_comment: The Hashsmith project's feedback board: the one cross-project HashOps target the scope hook allows (design §10, §12), and where /hashsmith:feedback files (the CLI's feedback-target). The project is public in HashOps, so every employee can create tasks on it and is the reporter of what they file. list_id is the Backlog list. An empty project_id or board_id means no scope exception for that field.
